method: Independent equations and numeric samples checked against authored scene coordinates and claims.
assumptions: Polar r=R cos(n theta), positive integer n. Negative radius places point opposite the chosen ray.

The four-cycle trace starts at radius zero theta=pi/8, so its first half-turn contains four complete center-to-center petals. Equal parameter speed is not constant drawing speed. A curve with odd n is retraced over the second half turn.
